one_sentence_story: When seven planted peers calmly pointed to an obviously wrong black line on a poster card, three out of four students publicly denied their own eyesight at least once — until a single truthful ally set them free.
so_what_for_you: In high-stakes meetings, collect people's votes silently in writing BEFORE the loudest voices speak, and remember that speaking one honest dissent drops everyone else's fear by eighty percent.
